2609.20027.title: Can Data Attribution Filter Out Subliminal Learning? Not Reliably
2609.20027.paper_summary: Subliminal learning allows language models to transmit behavioral traits through training data with no obvious semantic relationship to those traits, undermining content-based data filtering as a safety intervention. Training data attribution offers an alternative: it identifies the training examples responsible for a given model behavior, independent of their semantic content, and so may apply in exactly the cases where semantic inspection fails. We evaluate three gradient-based attribution methods (GradCos, a contrastive GradCos variant, and EK-FAC) across three models, comparing them against divergence tokens, a strong baseline previously shown to localize subliminal learning (albeit one that requires access to counterfactual teacher models). Filtering at the token level, EK-FAC mitigates a significant part of the effect, the other methods provide little benefit, and all mostly fall short of divergence tokens. Filtering entire samples is less effective for every method, though EK-FAC often gives a stronger signal than divergence tokens in this setting. Success is inconsistent across methods and settings: variants that work well for some model-preference combinations fail for others, and we do not identify a consistent explanation for these differences. Our results suggest that gradient-based attribution can identify data responsible for subliminal learning in some settings, but that some approximations are more reliable than others.
2609.20027.paper_summary_zh: 潛意識學習使語言模型能夠通過訓練數據傳遞行為特徵，而這些數據與這些特徵之間沒有明顯的語義關係，從而削弱了基於內容的數據過濾作為安全干預的效果。訓練數據歸因提供了一種替代方案：它識別出負責特定模型行為的訓練示例，與其語義內容無關，因此可能適用於語義檢查失敗的情況。我們評估了三種基於梯度的歸因方法（GradCos、一種對比的GradCos變體和EK-FAC），在三個模型中進行比較，並將它們與發散標記進行比較，後者是一個強有力的基線，先前已顯示能夠定位潛意識學習（儘管這需要訪問反事實教師模型）。在標記層級進行過濾時，EK-FAC減輕了相當一部分影響，而其他方法提供的好處不大，且大多數方法都未能超越發散標記。在每種方法中，對整個樣本的過濾效果較差，儘管在這種情況下EK-FAC通常提供比發散標記更強的信號。不同方法和設置的成功率不一致：對某些模型偏好組合有效的變體在其他情況下失敗，且我們未能找到這些差異的一致解釋。我們的結果表明，基於梯度的歸因可以在某些情況下識別出負責潛意識學習的數據，但某些近似方法比其他方法更可靠。
